title: Harness nudge compels a gap-note per nudge with no dedup/rate-limit and no orchestrator suppression → note-storm + unsatisfiable "stop noting" bind
wanted_capability:
(1) Dedup/rate-limit/coalesce the compelled gap-note directive: GAP_NOTE_DIRECTIVE (crates/bro-harness/src/hooks.rs:38) is appended to EVERY delivered nudge, instructing the agent to file bbox_note(kind=followup). Under sustained tool friction (a nudge per failed tool call) this produces a note-storm with no dedup by (tool, gap-class) — one driver produced 40 near-identical notes in ~25 min. (2) An orchestrator/operator-level suppression: there is currently NO way to quiet the directive for a dispatch, so an instruction like "stop emitting notes" directly conflicts with the harness directive and creates an unsatisfiable bind — the agent spirals (each new nudge forces a forbidden note). The agent's own notes named the cause: "erroneous bbox_note after explicit prohibition due hidden control path" (the hook).</wanted_capability>
<parameter name="missing_primitive">Per-(tool,gap-class) dedup in the nudge delivery path; and a dispatch-level flag / orchestrator signal that suppresses or down-weights GAP_NOTE_DIRECTIVE so "quiet down" is satisfiable instead of conflicting with the harness.
fallback_used: Orchestrator (me) misread the compelled notes as malfunction, told the bro to stop emitting notes (conflicting with the harness directive), which worsened the spiral; then manually resolved 40 notes. The DEFAULT_COMPLETION_CONTRACT (src/orchestration/mod.rs:1045) is deliberately quiet and does NOT compel notes — so the storm is specifically the nudge directive firing under friction.
notes: Discovered while dogfooding a codex driver bro driving `bro fleet` via tmux. The note-storm was itself the friction signal (the driver surfacing repeated tool friction as designed); the underlying triggers were a raw-shell-tmux brief instead of the tmux MCP surface, plus bro_resume scope/cwd confusion. This is the headline finding of the session.
resolution_note: Implemented focused nudge rider controls. GAP_NOTE_DIRECTIVE is no longer appended to every delivered nudge; it is session-deduped through NudgeLedger and delivered at most once per harness session. Added BRO_HARNESS_NUDGE_GAP_NOTES=0/false as a per-session env kill switch for the gap-note rider while leaving BRO_HARNESS_NUDGES steering enabled; both flags now resolve through the harness session-env resolver before process env, so daemon env_overrides work for in-process dispatches. Updated hook tests to cover first-rider delivery, later-rider suppression, rider-disabled nudges, and task-local session-env suppression. Validated with cargo test -p bro-harness hooks and cargo test -p bro-harness.
